data.hook: Light, breathable NOX Pro shorts in a soft grey-lilac.
why: Relaxed, flattering cut with a curved hem
data.summary: Part of NOX's Pro women's collection, these lightweight shorts are made for movement, with a breathable feel and a clean, sporty cut.

faq.q: Can I try the shorts on before buying?
faq.a: Yes. Tap "Keep it ready for me to see" and we'll have your size at the front desk to try on.
At the club front desk, the same way you pay for court bookings. There is no online payment.

data.clubTake: Brand new. Limited sizes in stock.
